rotation.topic: Bypassing Safety Controls · Stop Work Authority

openingMessage: Attitude is a choice. What you think you can do, whether positive or negative, confidence or scared, will most likely happen.
openingWhy: The crew that rolls out of this meeting believing the standard is doable holds it all day. The crew that decides at 5:30 AM that today's a goat rope builds themselves exactly that. You're not predicting your day in here — you're choosing it.
leadershipThought: A bypass that everyone knows about is still a bypass. Document it, restore it, or escalate it. Never normalize it. The next crew won't know what you left behind.

exxonMoments:
Stop Work Authority Exercised — Equipment Not Secured (Breaking Containment)
Before a wellhead reconnect, physically verify that all nearby equipment — including chemical totes — is secured and in position; don't assume the previous crew left the site ready.

Stop Work Authority Exercised — Unsafe Conditions (Operational Discipline)
Stop Work Authority is not a last resort — exercising it early when you identify an unsafe condition, and communicating it to the PIC for correction, is exactly how it is meant to be used.
